description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pohoddaramamulla, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
